scenes.prompt:
Use the last frame of clip 1 as the starting frame (extract it from clip 1 with ffmpeg; if you cannot extract it, use the decoded refs/v19-nha-tam.jpg.b64 from the repo as the scene reference). Keep the EXACT same woman as the reference photo: oval face, big bright sparkling eyes, light natural makeup, light pink lips, white-pink healthy skin with real texture, long brown hair in a low ponytail, no hair covering chest. Bust 106cm, waist 58cm, hips 90cm, height 190cm. She wears a plain light grey t-shirt, real home clothes. Same face, same t-shirt, same bathroom light as the first frame — do not change anything.

PRODUCT — use the real photos in the repo refs/ (decode refs/yujiao-logo.jpg.b64 for the logo and refs/yujiao-hinh-dang.jpg.b64 for shape/colors first): rectangular sponge, turquoise abrasive top layer and pale green base, copy its exact shape and exact colors. The logo is the dark grey word YUJIAO printed diagonally with a stylized YJ mark, exactly as in the logo photo. Do not invent any other text or logo.

Scene: static close-up of the sponge on the shower glass, split view: the left half of the frame still dirty white with calcium stains, the right half clear, shiny and transparent, the sponge sitting exactly on the border between dirty and clean. Her fingers relaxed, natural anatomy, 5 fingers, nails short and clean. The contrast must be obvious at first glance. One action only, max 10 seconds. No dialogue, let the image speak.

Negative: cartoon, CGI, plastic skin, extra fingers, deformed hands, changing face, changing outfit, blurry face, watermark, text overlay, logo, low quality.
